settings.heading: Five minutes.
settings.text: No twelve-step program. Five moves in the morning and three at night. Consistency beats everything.

settings.title: Cleanse
settings.text: Wash off the oil and dirt from the night. Lukewarm, not hot.

settings.title: Wake up
settings.text: Eye patches on while you make coffee.

settings.title: Massage
settings.text: Gua sha on moisturized skin: jaw, cheeks, forehead.

settings.title: Moisturize
settings.text: A pea-sized amount of tallow balm, spread thin.

settings.title: Style
settings.text: Sea salt spray into towel-dried hair, blow-dry, done.

settings.heading: Let it work overnight.
settings.note: Retinol for your skin, mouth tape and nose strips for nasal breathing while you sleep.
